title: The Wardrobe Workhorse: A Guide to the Versatile Blazer

langs.en:
What is a Blazer? Naval History, Key Features & How to Style It


If the suit jacket is your formal foundation, the blazer is your versatile workhorse. It is, quite simply, the single most useful tailored garment a man can own. It perfectly bridges the gap between formal and casual.

But what is a blazer? Its identity is defined by its details, born from a fascinating dual heritage.

1. The Dual Heritage of the Blazer
The Naval Heritage (The Uniform): The most-cited origin dates to 1837 and the captain of the HMS Blazer. To smarten his crew for a royal visit, he commissioned navy double-breasted jackets defined by their gleaming, contrasting brass buttons.

The Rowing Heritage (The Statement): Another origin comes from the 1820s "blazing red" flannel jackets of Cambridge's Lady Margaret Boat Club.

This history—part conservative uniform (navy) and part bold statement (color)—is why the blazer is so versatile today.

2. The Anatomy of a True Blazer
A blazer is not just a blue suit jacket. Its design is intentionally different.

Buttons: This is the key identifier. The buttons are always contrasting. Traditionally metal (brass, gold, or silver) , they are designed to "pop" against the fabric.

Structure: A blazer is designed for comfort. Modern blazers are often "unstructured"—meaning they have little to no shoulder padding. This is a specialty at Phan's Custom Tailor. We craft our blazers to feel as light as a cardigan, but as sharp as a suit.

Pockets: The most traditional style is the "Patch Pocket"—a pocket sewn onto the outside of the jacket, enhancing its relaxed, non-suit aesthetic.

3. How to Style the Workhorse
The blazer's versatility is unmatched. Pair it with a t-shirt and jeans , a polo and chinos , or a shirt, tie, and grey flannel trousers. It can be worn with sneakers or fine leather loafers.

An off-the-rack blazer is a compromise. A custom-made blazer from Phan's is a solution. It's the most versatile garment you'll own. Let's create yours.
